title: Edge outage and recovery
banner: CANDIDATE ORACLES, SYNTHETIC DATA, TEST-ONLY KEYS. NOT THE PLATFORM (it does not exist). No Azure resource is involved.

lines.text: Link up: 2 events reach the cell. The barge keeps capturing; the link then drops.
Link down: events 3, 4 and 5 are captured and signed at the edge, buffered, and cannot be sent. The transfer completes at sea.
Link returns; the buffer replays the LAST event first -> gap (the cell refuses to accept it ahead of its predecessors).
The buffer resends in order, including already-sent event 2 -> accepted 3, duplicates ignored 1, rejected 0.
A full replay of everything -> accepted 0, duplicates 5 (idempotent: nothing is counted twice).
Evidence complete and independently verified: ok=true, complete=true, delivered 2500.0 kg.
Receipt times come from the cell's clock, not the device: first 2026-03-10T09:15:00.000Z, last 2026-03-10T11:45:00.000Z. Late data is visible as late, never back-dated.
Limit: this is the contract on one in-memory verifier. Real edge hardware, storage, retry behaviour and the trusted time source are not built (D-018, D-021).
